name: omran-ai-builder
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; if [ ! -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then mkdir -p "$NVM_DIR"; curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.3/install.sh | bash; fi; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 >/dev/null; nvm use 24 >/dev/null; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; node -v; npm ci

terminals.name: static-server
terminals.description: Serves the static frontend (index.html, bundle, assets) at http://localhost:3000 for previewing the app.
